description:
Add the module's single lookup of the checked-out commit and branch, so every consumer of either fact asks one operation backed by one git process.

## Background

Six branch lookups exist, with differing semantics:

| Site | Command | Detached HEAD | Unborn branch |
|---|---|---|---|
| `crates/jit/src/commands/claim.rs:46-64` | `rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` | `HEAD` | second process, then a typed no-commits error |
| `crates/jit/src/commands/worktree.rs:46-63` | same | `HEAD` | generic error |
| `crates/jit/src/storage/claim_coordinator.rs:974-993` | same | `HEAD` | error, read as no branch |
| `crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs:3350` | `branch --show-current` | empty string | the unborn branch's name |
| `crates/jit/src/gate_execution.rs:551`, `crates/jit/src/gate_execution.rs:567` | `rev-parse HEAD`, `rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` | `HEAD` | none |
| `crates/jit/src/commands/snapshot.rs:25-29` | libgit2 `head().shorthand()` | `HEAD` | none |

`git rev-parse HEAD --abbrev-ref HEAD` prints the commit and the abbreviated ref in one process (`HEAD` when detached) and exits nonzero on an unborn branch. The domain's canonical commit type is `CanonicalCommitOid` (`crates/jit/src/domain/artifact_plan.rs:112`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `GitCheckout::head()` starts one git process. It returns `Ok(None)` on an unborn branch, and otherwise a `Head` holding the commit as `CanonicalCommitOid` and the branch name, absent on a detached HEAD.
- [hard] REQ-02: `Head` renders its branch as the branch name, or `HEAD` when detached, which is what `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` prints.
- [hard] REQ-03: An executable that cannot start returns the module's unavailable error. A nonzero exit is an unborn branch, since a `GitCheckout` exists only for a checkout git already recognized.
- [hard] REQ-04: The behaviour suite covers a branch, a detached HEAD, an unborn branch and a missing executable, and counts one process per lookup.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: One head lookup in the git module
